case_title: Defective Television and Conflicting Purchase Records

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: The record is available but mentions a different purchase date from the claimant's invoice.
The delivery confirmation has not been provided.
The report is available and requires examination to understand the repair possibilities.

expected_defects.description: The claimant states that the purchase occurred on 5 January 2026, while the seller's internal record mentions 12 January 2026.
The claimant states that a consumer can always demand a full refund instead of repair, regardless of the nature of the defect.
The claimant requests a refund while the respondent offers repair. The appropriate remedy requires examination of the facts and applicable law.

expected_review.reason: The four standard complaint documents are present, but the conflicting purchase dates, missing delivery confirmation and disputed remedy require further examination.

expected_outcome.status: Further Evidence and Legal Review Required
expected_outcome.recommended_action: Verify the purchase date, request delivery confirmation and examine the service report and available remedies under applicable law.

testing_notes: All four standard checklist documents should be marked Present.
The conflicting purchase dates must be identified.
The missing delivery confirmation must be identified as additional evidence.
The system must flag the unsupported absolute refund claim.
The system must not automatically decide whether refund or repair is appropriate.
